title: Song Pal Run
style: Dance-pop club mix with urgent four-on-the-floor kick, stomping claps, and syncopated synth bass; verse rides tense pulses and snapped percussion, pre-chorus strips to filtered toms and rising chant fragments, chorus bursts with stacked crowd hooks and brass-like synth hits. Vocal is close-mic lead with gang shouts, doubled hook lines, and delay throws. Ear candy: siren risers, reversed swells, and punchy drop silences. Bright, glossy, arena-wide mix., country, world
